items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Stock Looks Undervalued On Fair Value And Earnings
items.summary: Wells Fargo stock has delivered a strong 137.3% return over the past 3 years, yet several valuation checks still suggest the shares may trade below an internally estimated intrinsic value. With both the Excess Returns model and market multiples pointing in the same direction, the current price invites closer scrutiny of what investors are paying for the bank’s progress and plans.
